==============================================================================
host-browser/src/worker.ts
==============================================================================
// The worker hosting the heads: every head over one store, in the browser and
// with no backend. The page reaches each head over a `MessagePort` of its own.

// First, before any class carrying a decorator loads: GLSP reads the metadata
// its decorators emit as each class is defined.
import 'reflect-metadata';
import { ServerModule } from '@eclipse-glsp/server/browser.js';
import { persistentFileSystem } from '@hydranium/core';
import { hostHeadsInWorker, IndexedDbFileSystemStore, startLanguageServerInWorker } from '@hydranium/core/browser';
import { DataServer } from '@hydranium/data-server';
import { startDataServerInWorker } from '@hydranium/data-server/browser';
import { GlspClientLogger, HydraniumGlspAppModule } from '@hydranium/glsp-server';
import { startGlspServerInWorker } from '@hydranium/glsp-server/browser';
import type { BookstoreModel } from 'bookstore-protocol';
import { BookstoreDiagramModule, createBookstoreServices } from 'bookstore-server';
import { WORKSPACE_ROOT_URI } from './workspace.js';

/** The files of `../workspace`, read by `esbuild.mjs` and keyed by their path below the root. */
declare const __WORKSPACE_SEED__: Record<string, string>;
/** This project's directory, hashed by `esbuild.mjs`, so that no other project on the origin opens its store. */
declare const __DIRECTORY_KEY__: string;

// A saved file is kept in IndexedDB and laid over the seed on the next load;
// the heads start once the stored files are restored.
const store = new IndexedDbFileSystemStore(`bookstore-workspace-${__DIRECTORY_KEY__}`);

hostHeadsInWorker(
   persistentFileSystem({ store, seed: __WORKSPACE_SEED__, rootUri: WORKSPACE_ROOT_URI }),
   (ports, fileSystem) => {
      // The LSP head composes the services, as the Node entry does around stdio.
      const shared = startLanguageServerInWorker(
         ports.lsp,
         connection => createBookstoreServices({ connection, ...fileSystem }).shared
      );
      // The data head serves from the LSP head's store, on its own port.
      startDataServerInWorker(ports.data, shared, connection => new DataServer<BookstoreModel>(connection, shared));
      const glsp = startGlspServerInWorker({
         context: ports.glsp,
         createLogger: caller => new GlspClientLogger(shared, { component: caller }),
         serverModule: new ServerModule().configureDiagramModule(new BookstoreDiagramModule()),
         appModules: [new HydraniumGlspAppModule({ shared })]
      });
      // The GLSP head reports a failed start through `started`, which the
      // ready message waits for.
      return { shared, started: [glsp.started] };
   },
   // The ready message then carries the workspace files the page opens.
   { rootUri: WORKSPACE_ROOT_URI }
);

==============================================================================
host-browser/src/page.ts
==============================================================================
// The page: it starts the worker, hands each head a channel of its own, and
// fills the pane of each head the server runs, one after the other.

import { connectWorkerHeads } from '@hydranium/client-browser';
import { ConsoleLogger, describeError } from '@hydranium/protocol';
import { showDataStatus } from './data-status.js';
import { mountDiagram } from './diagram.js';
import { startEditor } from './editor.js';
import { appendLog, setStatus } from './log.js';
import { WORKSPACE_ROOT_URI } from './workspace.js';

/** Where the worker bundle is served, substituted by `esbuild.mjs`. */
declare const __WORKER_BUNDLE_URL__: string;

async function main(): Promise<void> {
   // The page's end of each head's connection logs to the browser console.
   const logger = new ConsoleLogger();
   const heads = connectWorkerHeads(new Worker(__WORKER_BUNDLE_URL__), { logger });
   heads.onWorkerError(report => appendLog(`worker error during ${report.phase}: ${report.message}`));
   setStatus('starting…');
   await startEditor(heads);
   await showDataStatus(heads.data, `${WORKSPACE_ROOT_URI}/nodes.bookstore`);
   await mountDiagram(heads.glsp, `${WORKSPACE_ROOT_URI}/nodes.bookstore`, logger);
   setStatus('ready');
}

main().catch((error: unknown) => setStatus(`failed: ${describeError(error)}`));

==============================================================================
host-browser/src/editor.ts
==============================================================================
// The LSP part of the page: one Monaco editor over the LSP head, a switch
// between the workspace files, and Save. The worker holds the files, so the
// page saves through the LSP head and the worker writes them to IndexedDB.

import { initializeLanguageClient, type WorkerHeads } from '@hydranium/client-browser';
import { MONACO_CLIENT_CAPABILITIES, MonacoLspClient } from '@hydranium/client-browser/monaco';
import { describeError } from '@hydranium/protocol';
import { ALL_LANGUAGES } from 'bookstore-protocol';
import { PublishDiagnosticsNotification } from 'vscode-languageserver-protocol';
import { appendLog, setStatus } from './log.js';
import { WORKSPACE_ROOT_URI } from './workspace.js';

/** Where Monaco's own worker bundle is served, substituted by `esbuild.mjs`. */
declare const __MONACO_WORKER_BUNDLE_URL__: string;

// Before any editor exists: Monaco otherwise looks for a worker script no
// bundle emits, and fails on the first edit.
self.MonacoEnvironment = { getWorker: () => new Worker(__MONACO_WORKER_BUNDLE_URL__) };

/** Each language as Monaco registers it, from the ids and extensions the server generates. */
const LANGUAGES = ALL_LANGUAGES.map(language => ({
   id: language.languageId,
   extensions: [...language.fileExtensions]
}));

/** Run the LSP handshake, then show the first workspace file in the editor. */
export async function startEditor(heads: WorkerHeads): Promise<void> {
   let client!: MonacoLspClient;
   await initializeLanguageClient(heads.lsp, {
      rootUri: WORKSPACE_ROOT_URI,
      capabilities: MONACO_CLIENT_CAPABILITIES,
      onLogMessage: params => appendLog(params.message),
      // Before `initialized`, since the server publishes from then on.
      beforeInitialized: result => {
         client = new MonacoLspClient(heads.lsp, result.capabilities, { languages: LANGUAGES });
         heads.lsp.onNotification(PublishDiagnosticsNotification.type, params => client.applyDiagnostics(params));
      }
   });

   // The text comes from the worker rather than the seed, since a saved edit
   // is laid over the seed there.
   const { workspace } = await heads.ready;
   if (workspace === undefined) {
      throw new Error('the worker sent no workspace files');
   }
   // Only the files a language claims: the client refuses to open any other.
   const paths = Object.keys(workspace.files)
      .filter(path => LANGUAGES.some(language => language.extensions.some(extension => path.endsWith(extension))))
      .sort();
   if (paths.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('no workspace file has a language extension');
   }
   const uriOf = (path: string): string => `${WORKSPACE_ROOT_URI}/${path}`;
   const modelOf = (path: string) => client.openDocument(uriOf(path), workspace.files[path]);

   const select = document.getElementById('file') as HTMLSelectElement;
   // The worker keys each file by its encoded path, as in its URI: shown decoded.
   select.append(...paths.map(path => new Option(decodeURIComponent(path), path)));
   const editor = client.createEditor(document.getElementById('editor') as HTMLElement, modelOf(paths[0]), {
      automaticLayout: true,
      minimap: { enabled: false },
      scrollBeyondLastLine: false
   });
   const show = (path: string): void => {
      select.value = path;
      editor.setModel(modelOf(path));
   };
   select.addEventListener('change', () => show(select.value));

   // Go to definition across files switches the editor to the target file.
   client.registerEditorOpener((uri, position) => {
      const path = paths.find(candidate => uriOf(candidate) === uri);
      if (path === undefined) {
         return false;
      }
      show(path);
      editor.setPosition(position);
      editor.revealPositionInCenter(position);
      return true;
   });

   const save = (): void => {
      client.saveAll().then(
         saved => setStatus(`saved ${saved.length} file(s)`),
         (error: unknown) => setStatus(`save failed: ${describeError(error)}`)
      );
   };
   (document.getElementById('save') as HTMLButtonElement).addEventListener('click', save);
   // Ctrl+S (Cmd+S) saves too, in place of the browser's "Save page as".
   window.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      if ((event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) && event.key.toLowerCase() === 's') {
         event.preventDefault();
         save();
      }
   });
   // Asks before a reload or a closed tab drops an unsaved edit.
   window.addEventListener('beforeunload', event => {
      if (client.dirtyDocuments().length > 0) {
         event.preventDefault();
      }
   });
   (document.getElementById('editor-pane') as HTMLElement).hidden = false;
}

==============================================================================
host-browser/src/data-status.ts
==============================================================================
// The data part of the page: one document read through the data head, out of
// the same store the editor's LSP head serves.

import { DataConnectionWithEvents, type DataPort } from '@hydranium/protocol';
import type { BookstoreElement } from 'bookstore-protocol';

/** Open `uri` through the data head and say what it holds on the status line below the editor. */
export async function showDataStatus(port: DataPort, uri: string): Promise<void> {
   const session = new DataConnectionWithEvents<BookstoreElement>(port).createSession('bookstore-page');
   const opened = await session.openDocument({ uri });
   const line = document.getElementById('data-status') as HTMLElement;
   line.textContent = `data head: ${uri.slice(uri.lastIndexOf('/') + 1)} holds a ${opened.model?.root.$type ?? 'document with no model'}`;
   line.hidden = false;
}

==============================================================================
host-browser/src/diagram.ts
==============================================================================
// The GLSP part of the page: the Bookstore diagram of one document, drawn by
// the client module every host of this project mounts.

import type { WorkerHeads } from '@hydranium/client-browser';
import { glspConnection, HydraniumGlspClient, mountGlspDiagram } from '@hydranium/glsp-client';
import { describeError, type Logger } from '@hydranium/protocol';
import { initializeBookstoreDiagramContainer } from 'bookstore-client';
import { BOOKSTORE_DIAGRAM_TYPE } from 'bookstore-protocol';

/** Show the diagram of `sourceUri` in the page's diagram pane. */
export async function mountDiagram(connection: WorkerHeads['glsp'], sourceUri: string, logger: Logger): Promise<void> {
   // Shown before the mount, which measures the element it draws into.
   (document.getElementById('diagram-pane') as HTMLElement).hidden = false;
   const glspClient = new HydraniumGlspClient({ id: 'diagram', connectionProvider: glspConnection(connection) });
   const { loadOutcome } = await mountGlspDiagram({
      mount: document.getElementById('diagram') as HTMLElement,
      diagramType: BOOKSTORE_DIAGRAM_TYPE,
      sourceUri,
      glspClient,
      initializeDiagramContainer: initializeBookstoreDiagramContainer,
      logger
   });
   if (loadOutcome.status === 'failed') {
      throw new Error(`the diagram did not load: ${describeError(loadOutcome.error)}`);
   }
}

==============================================================================
host-browser/src/log.ts
==============================================================================
// The page's status line and log area. A worker has no console anyone reads,
// so what the server logs and the worker reports is shown here.

/** Replace the one-line status in the title bar. */
export function setStatus(text: string): void {
   (document.getElementById('status') as HTMLElement).textContent = text;
}

/** Add a line to the log area, kept scrolled to its end. */
export function appendLog(text: string): void {
   const log = document.getElementById('log') as HTMLElement;
   log.append(`${text}\n`);
   log.scrollTop = log.scrollHeight;
}

==============================================================================
host-browser/src/posix-path-shim.ts
==============================================================================
// The one function of Node's `path` the framework imports, for the bundle to
// resolve: `esbuild.mjs` points the bare `path` specifier here, while a
// `node:path` import still fails the bundle. Only a workspace folder given as
// a filesystem path reaches it, which the page, naming a URI, never does.

/** Resolve `segments` right to left into one absolute path, as `path.posix.resolve` does from `/`. */
export function resolve(...segments: string[]): string {
   let resolved = '';
   for (let i = segments.length - 1; i >= 0 && !resolved.startsWith('/'); i--) {
      if (segments[i].length > 0) {
         resolved = resolved.length === 0 ? segments[i] : `${segments[i]}/${resolved}`;
      }
   }
   const parts: string[] = [];
   for (const part of resolved.split('/')) {
      if (part === '..') {
         parts.pop();
      } else if (part !== '' && part !== '.') {
         parts.push(part);
      }
   }
   return `/${parts.join('/')}`;
}

==============================================================================
host-browser/test/smoke.spec.mts
==============================================================================
// The page loads with every head answering, and an edit saved through the
// LSP head is still there after a reload. Any console error fails it.

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';

test('loads every head and keeps a saved edit across a reload', async ({ page }) => {
   const errors: string[] = [];
   page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message));
   page.on('console', message => {
      if (message.type() === 'error') {
         errors.push(message.text());
      }
   });
   const editor = page.locator('#editor .view-lines');

   await page.goto('/');
   await expect(page.locator('#status')).toHaveText('ready');
   await expect(editor).toContainText('node First');
   // The data head reads the document out of the same store.
   await expect(page.locator('#data-status')).toHaveText('data head: nodes.bookstore holds a BookstoreModel');
   // The two starter nodes, drawn.
   await expect(page.locator('#diagram .sprotty-node')).toHaveCount(2);

   await editor.click();
   await page.keyboard.press('ControlOrMeta+End');
   await page.keyboard.type('\nnode Added');
   await page.locator('#save').click();
   await expect(page.locator('#status')).toHaveText('saved 1 file(s)');

   await page.reload();
   await expect(page.locator('#status')).toHaveText('ready');
   await expect(editor).toContainText('node Added');
   expect(errors).toEqual([]);
});
